definitions.explanation: A portable audio device or app that provides recorded commentary and explanations at museums, tourist sites, historic buildings, and other cultural venues.

examples.japanese: {音声|おんせい}ガイド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音声|おんせい}ガイド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used an English audio guide at the art museum.

examples.japanese: {音声|おんせい}ガイド⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the audio guide, I understood the exhibits well.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{音声|おんせい}→音声：04445_onsei⟧ (voice/audio) and ⟦ガイド→ガイド：05116_gaido⟧ (guide). Commonly available at museums, temples, castles, and other cultural sites in Japan. Many venues offer audio guides in multiple languages, making them valuable for foreign visitors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音声|おんせい}ガイド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧: to borrow/rent an audio guide
- {音声|おんせい}ガイド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧: to return an audio guide
- {音声|おんせい}ガイド⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with audio guide included
- {多言語|たげんご}{音声|おんせい}ガイド: multilingual audio guide

PRACTICAL NOTE:
Audio guides at Japanese museums typically cost 500-600 yen to rent. Increasingly, venues offer smartphone-based audio guides via QR codes or dedicated apps, sometimes at no extra cost.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ガイドブック: guidebook — a printed travel guide
- ⟦パンフレット→パンフレット：19127_panfuretto⟧: pamphlet/brochure — the printed materials available at venues
